technical.title: Evaluating Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Long-Tail Driving Edge Cases
technical.summary: STRIDE is an object-centric benchmark designed to evaluate whether vision-language models connect past spatial observations to future consequences in safety-critical driving scenarios.
technical.why: It matters because autonomous driving requires understanding how objects move and interact over time to avoid dangerous decisions.

technical.title: Trimodal LiDAR-RGB-Thermal Dataset and Method for 3D Search and Rescue
technical.summary: TriSAR-3D is a multimodal dataset capturing varied human poses in rescue environments to improve 3D person detection beyond narrow automotive settings.
technical.why: It matters for improving rescue robotics and first responder situational awareness in unstructured environments.

technical.title: Efficient Spatial Reasoning Using Bird's-Eye-View Visual Tokens
technical.summary: Cambrian-BEV extends Cambrian-S with a parameter-free geometric tokenization scheme that establishes stable spatial correspondence across viewpoints and time for embodied agents.
technical.why: It matters by providing persistent spatial context for video multimodal large language models.

technical.title: Learning to Think and Explore in 3D Environments Using VLMs
technical.summary: This research studies how vision-language models can interact with 3D spaces through actions and single images, iteratively reasoning and navigating before answering.
technical.why: It matters for advancing active exploration capabilities in vision-language models.

technical.title: SpatialBEV Improves Off-Road Vehicle Dynamics Learning
technical.summary: SpatialBEV exploits the spatial structure of off-road terrain interaction by querying bird's-eye-view feature representations to improve vehicle dynamics models.
technical.why: It matters for achieving accurate control during high-speed autonomous off-road navigation.

technical.title: VLA-Fabric Coordinates Interaction in Multi-Arm Robotic Agents
technical.summary: VLA-Fabric organizes one complete vision-language-action model per arm while preserving local perception and action ownership to coordinate multi-arm manipulation systems.
technical.why: It matters by exploring explicit interaction strategies between action-producing VLAs in multi-arm setups.

technical.title: Voxel51 3.0 Combines Multimodal Data Platform Tools for Physical AI
technical.summary: Voxel51 3.0 merges sensor data search, curation, annotation, and evaluation into one platform, adding the Voxel51 Agent with 45+ MCP tools and a self-service tier.
technical.why: It matters for physical AI teams managing and evaluating multimodal sensor data.

technical.title: Kyutai REKI Brings Efficient Memory to Robot Manipulation
technical.summary: Kyutai, Inria, and École des Ponts released REKI, a 2.4B VLA model pretrained on public data that carries a cheap memory of its recent past for robot manipulation.
technical.why: It matters by delivering high-performing robot manipulation capabilities in a smaller, efficient model size.

technical.title: Evaluating LLM Agent Scientific Judgment Using a New Benchmark
technical.summary: SciΠvot is a 248-case benchmark built from six months of research records to evaluate scientific judgment in LLM agents based on human corrections.
technical.why: It matters because reliable autonomous research requires accurate judgment during open-ended project decisions.

technical.title: SimpleVLN Framework for Frontier Vision-Language Navigation
technical.summary: SimpleVLN is an architecture-preserving framework developed through studies of navigation formulation, data construction, and optimization to unlock native MLLM potential for navigation.
technical.why: It matters by streamlining vision-and-language navigation without relying on complex task-specific architectures.

business.title: Nvidia Veteran Says Physical AI Robotics In Lego Era
business.summary: Amulya Vishwanath states robotics is in its Lego era with basic building blocks still being rebuilt, countering general foundation model views.
business.why: Understanding hardware and component maturity is vital for autonomous system and robotics engineering.

business.title: Websites Close Their Doors To Autonomous AI Agents
business.summary: As autonomous agents from OpenAI, Meta, Google, and others scour the internet, websites are closing their doors and refusing to play nice.
business.why: Website blocks against autonomous agents alter data accessibility for web-scouting systems.

business.title: Asia Startup Funding Reaches Near Record High Driven By AI
business.summary: Investors put $38.5 billion into seed- through growth-stage financings for Asian startups in Q3, with a majority going to AI-focused companies.
business.why: Asia's massive capital injection into AI signals strong regional market growth and investment opportunities.

business.title: Startup Investors Scale Back Giant Rounds For Latest AI Batch
business.summary: Startup investors scaled back on giant rounds this past week, with just two startup financings in the multiple hundreds of millions.
business.why: Venture capital slowdowns in giant AI rounds could impact early-stage valuation trends.

business.title: Disney Agrees To Hire Majority Of Character AI Workforce
business.summary: The vast majority of Character.AI employees offered jobs at Disney accepted them, though this remains a stalking horse bid subject to higher offers.
business.why: Talent acquisitions and workforce shifts among conversational AI labs signal changing industry dynamics.

business.title: Woman Arrested In Philadelphia For Blocking Delivery Robot
business.summary: Carolyn Marvin was arrested and charged with disorderly conduct after blocking an Uber delivery robot to protest jobs taken from human workers.
business.why: Public pushback against autonomous delivery robots highlights real-world deployment frictions.

business.title: Meta Removes Language That May Have Allowed News Scraping
business.summary: Meta is updating its terms to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites and news sites to train its AI.
business.why: Scraping policy changes impact how foundation models source web data for training.

business.title: CXMT Shares Fall Nearly 8% Following Earnings Forecast
business.summary: CXMT shares fell nearly 8% on Monday after the company released its earnings forecast for the first nine months of 2026.
business.why: Market reactions to chipmaker forecasts impact the broader hardware supply chain.

business.title: Anthropic Commits 5% Of Its Shares To Public Benefit Fund
business.summary: Anthropic said that it will commit 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund.
business.why: Corporate structure shifts in major AI labs affect industry governance and strategic alignment.

business.title: AI Stocks Plunge While Inflation Heats Up Markets
business.summary: The sinking AI trade rattled last week's market, though solid bank earnings and a rotation beyond tech provided optimism.
business.why: Broader market corrections in AI stocks can influence tech sector budgets and valuations.

models.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 Introduces First Open-Source MoE Model for On-Device Inference
models.summary: MiniCPM-V 4.7 is available in a 35B-A3B variant, representing the first MoE model in the series. It combines single-image, multi-image, and video understanding with Lookahead Expert Scheduling for smooth on-device inference.
models.why: This brings advanced multi-image and video understanding capabilities directly to edge hardware.

models.title: Google DeepMind Launches EmbeddingGemma 2 Open Multimodal Embedding Model
models.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 maps text, code, images, video, and audio into a single 768-dimensional vector space. With 740M parameters, it is designed for low-latency on-device applications like search and RAG.
models.why: It provides a unified, lightweight multimodal embedding solution for consumer hardware.

models.title: DeepSeek Releases V4.1-Flash-1017 Update With Visual Benchmark Improvements
models.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks while reducing execution time and output length.
models.why: It advances the performance-cost Pareto frontier for multimodal agent tasks.

models.title: LiquidAI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B Reasoning Model For On-Device Agents
models.summary: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24B-parameter reasoning model with 2B active parameters built for fast, private on-device agents, delivering competitive tool-use performance and efficient inference speeds.
models.why: It provides efficient, low-latency reasoning capabilities suitable for edge agentic applications.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1 Uncensored Quantized Formats Released For Local Generation
models.summary: A collection of GGUF, Safetensors, and MLX quantized formats of Qwen-Image-2.1 has been released for local image generation using ComfyUI with upstream base weights.
models.why: It enables running local image generation pipelines efficiently across diverse consumer hardware.

models.title: OpenMOSS-Team Releases MOSS-Image-SFT Supervised Fine-Tuned Model
models.summary: MOSS-Image-SFT is a supervised fine-tuned text-to-image model derived from MOSS-Image-Base, supporting natural-language prompts, tag sequences, and JSON layouts for precise text placement and object arrangement.
models.why: It offers enhanced control over layout arrangement and text grouping in generated images.
